listing.name: Profit Creation Drugs
listing.aiSummary: Recolors all recreational drugs in the Persean Sector to a rainbow theme.

description: Temporarily changes the appearance of all recreational drugs found in the game. The visual change is described as a celebration of basic human dignities within the Tri-Tachyon Corporation's narrative.

discordPostHtml:
Tri-Tachyon Corporation Announcement Voice:

“Congratulations, [Homosexual]! Your existence has been deemed profitable in the [Core Worlds] region.”

“To celebrate the occasion we have temporarily recolored  all [Recreational Drugs] in the Persean Sector region to your favorite flavor of [gay].”

“For further pandering on a wider area please continue fighting for [basic human dignities] and Tri-Tachyon Corporation will be right there to celebrate your victory with you. Afterwards.”
